title: Giant Australia Defy Advanced SL 1 (2026) product page
notes: Official 2026 Australia page opened on 2026-09-25 after literal URL absence check. Lines 184 and 445-447 identify the Defy Advanced SL 1 and state that each bike should be weighed by a dealer because weight varies with size, finish, hardware and accessories. No numeric complete-bike weight is published, and the page does not map the community-reported 7.4 kg bike to a year, size or build.
